evals.prompt: Look at my last 3 covers and give me a prompt template to keep new covers consistent. https://thepipeandtheline.substack.com
evals.success_criteria: Loads visual-brand first, fetches the cover of each article and returns a brand template prompt with [variable] placeholders in a code block.
evals.rubric: The answer has one line per cover, flags outliers, and gives a brand template prompt that covers palette, lighting, layout, style, mood and the format 'portrait 2:3'.
